abilityTextEn: Shuffle all cards from each player's graveyard back into their decks.
quoteEn: "A king's gotta be wise. A king's gotta command respect. A king's gotta have stones."

nameEn: Emhyr var Emreis: Emperor of Nilfgaard
abilityTextEn: Look at 3 random cards from your opponent's hand.
quoteEn: "Your motives do not interest me. Only results."

nameEn: Emhyr var Emreis: His Imperial Majesty
abilityTextEn: Pick a Torrential Rain card from your deck and play it instantly.
quoteEn: "The skies wept when my Pavetta died. They will not weep for me."

nameEn: Emhyr var Emreis: Invader of the North
abilityTextEn: Abilities that restore a unit to the battlefield restore a randomly-chosen unit. Affects both players.
quoteEn: "Emperors command magnitudes, yet cannot control two things: their time and their hearts."

abilityTextEn: Draw a card from your opponent's discard pile.
quoteEn: "They do not call me the Patient. Take care they do not call you the Headless."

nameEn: Emhyr var Emreis: The White Flame
abilityTextEn: Cancel your opponent's Leader Ability.
quoteEn: "A sword is but one of many tools at a rules's disposal."

abilityTextEn: Doubles the strength of all spy cards (affects both players).
quoteEn: "I'm enjoying this. You are my toy."

abilityTextEn: Restore a card from your discard pile to your hand.
quoteEn: "Go on. Show me your spins, pirouettes and feints. I want to watch."

nameEn: Eredin: Commander of the Red Riders
abilityTextEn: Double the strength of all your Close Combat units (unless a Commander's horn is also present on that row).
quoteEn: "Have some dignity. You know how this will end."

abilityTextEn: Discard 2 card and draw 1 card of your choice from your deck.
quoteEn: "It is unavoidable."

nameEn: Eredin: King of the Wild Hunt
abilityTextEn: Pick any weather card from your deck and play it instantly.
quoteEn: "I've long awaited this…"

abilityTextEn: Pick an Impenetrable Fog card from your deck and play it instantly.
quoteEn: "It is natural and beautiful that a man should love his sister."

nameEn: Foltest: Lord Commander of the North
abilityTextEn: Clear any weather effects (resulting from Biting Frost, Torrential Rain or Impenetrable Fog cards) in play.
quoteEn: "Sod advisors and their schemes. I place my trust in my soldiers' blades."

abilityTextEn: Destroy your enemy's strongest Ranged Combat unit(s) if the combined strength of all his or her Ranged Combat units is 10 or more.
quoteEn: "Dammit, I rule this land and I refuse to creep around its corners."

abilityTextEn: Doubles the strength of all your Siege units (unless a Commander's Horn is also present on that row).
quoteEn: "A well-aimed ballista razes not just the enemy's walls, but his morale as well."

abilityTextEn: Destroy your enemy's strongest Siege unit(s) if the combined strength of all his or her Siege units is 10 or more.
quoteEn: "A beautiful day for battle."

nameEn: Francesca Findabair: Daisy of the Valley
abilityTextEn: Draw an extra card at the beginning of the battle
quoteEn: "The Elder Races have forgotten more than humans can ever hope to know."

nameEn: Francesca Findabair: Hope of the Aen Seidhe
abilityTextEn: Move agile units to whichever valid row maximizes their strength (don't move units already in optimal row).
quoteEn: "Daede sian caente, Aen Seidhe en'allane ael coeden…"

abilityTextEn: Pick a Biting Frost card from your deck and play it instantly.
quoteEn: "Ash shall fertilize the soil. By spring, the valley shall bloom once more."

nameEn: Francesca Findabair: Queen of Dol Blathanna
abilityTextEn: Destroy your enemy's strongest Close Combat unit(s) if the combined strength of all his or her Close Combat units is 10 or more.
quoteEn: "To live in peace, we first must kill. This is human opression's cruel finale."

abilityTextEn: Doubles the strength of all your Ranged Combat units (unless a Commander's Horn is also present on that row).
quoteEn: "Do not let my beauty distract your aim."

abilityTextEn: Units only lose half their Strength in bad weather conditions.
quoteEn: "No one can replace Bran. Though they're sure to try."
